'''Hugo Eckener''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as [[Chief Architect]] in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] during the [[Republic Era|Fall of the Republic]]. As a [[minister]], he advised the [[monarch of Naboo]] and guided public policy on [[Naboo]].<ref name="CVD" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Eckener was present in the [[Theed Royal Palace]] during the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="Episode I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character shares his name with [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_Eckener Hugo Eckener], a commander of the ''Graf Zeppelin'' and starch opponent to the Nazi regime.
